name: Pitchfork normal form divided above twice the threshold
question: Is the order kept when the daughters are born above the threshold?
assumptions: benchmark written without a field: dphi/dt = a (L - L_c) phi - b phi^3 with a = b = L_c = 1
exponential growth at the rate 0.05; division at 2.4 L_c, so the daughters are born at 1.2 L_c

provenance.source: normal form of a pitchfork with the size as its control (mission 7, law 2)
